title: Princess 68
highlights: Ready to sail, no work required
description:
This 2017 Princess 68 was bought new and has had a single owner since, presented in excellent condition after rigorous maintenance. She is ready to sail with no work required.

She comes with two Onan 19 kW generators, a fin stabiliser, a Williams Turbojet 385 tender, a full Raymarine navigation system and raised side rails. She is lying in Antibes, France.
